official: 調布市印鑑条例の一部を改正する条例

令和8年第2回定例会会議結果

name: 端末での印鑑登録証明の申請方法を変更
summary: 多機能端末機を使った印鑑登録証明の申請について、条例に定める手続きが改められます。申請の方法などを条例に列挙する形から、規則で定める形に変更します。
changes: 多機能端末機での申請方法を規則で定める形に改める
who: 多機能端末機で印鑑登録証明を申請する人
why: 出入国管理及び難民認定法等の一部改正を踏まえ、多機能端末機を使った印鑑登録証明の申請について改めるためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Changes how people apply for seal registration certificates using terminals
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Chofu City Seal Registration Ordinance
en.summary: The procedures set out in the ordinance for applying for seal registration certificates using multifunction terminals will be revised. Instead of listing the application method and other details in the ordinance, the city will set them out in its rules.
changes: Sets the application method for multifunction terminals in rules rather than listing it in the ordinance
who: People applying for seal registration certificates using multifunction terminals
en.why: The city says this is to revise applications for seal registration certificates using multifunction terminals in light of partial amendments to the Immigration Control and Refugee Recognition Act and other laws.
